faq.includesQ: What exactly does the Ads+ Plan include?
faq.includesA: Everything in the Visibility Plan + €30 of real ad spend every month + full campaign management (creatives, copy, targeting, optimisation) + a weekly metrics report.
faq.platformQ: Can I choose which platform to advertise on?
faq.platformA: Yes. Each month you choose ONE platform from Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn or Google Search. You can switch the following month if you like.
faq.noBriefingQ: What happens if I don't fill in the monthly briefing?
faq.noBriefingA: We send you reminders on the 1st, 3rd and 5th. If you haven't filled it in by the 6th, we copy the previous month's setup so you don't lose the month.
faq.budgetQ: Is the €30 real ad spend, or does it include management?
faq.budgetA: The full €30 goes into your campaign (pure ad budget). Management, creatives and copy are already covered by the plan's €33.
faq.cancelQ: Can I cancel whenever I want?
faq.cancelA: Yes, no lock-in. You cancel from your dashboard and your campaign ends at the end of the current month.
faq.launchTimeQ: How long does it take to launch my campaign?
faq.launchTimeA: Once you approve the briefing and the creatives (usually 24-48h), your campaign goes live within another 24-48h.

identity.subtitle: Basic information about your business
identity.nameTooltip: Your professional name is the first thing clients see. Use your real name or your business name. Examples: 'Juan Pérez - Plumber', 'Electricidad Rodríguez', etc.
identity.nameHint: This is how clients will see it
identity.contactTooltip: Choose how you want clients to contact you. The in-app chat is required and secure. WhatsApp and phone are optional but bring you more contacts.

activity.title: Activity and services
activity.subtitle: What services do you offer?
activity.categoryTooltip: Choose the category that best describes your main activity. Clients search by category, so pick the most relevant one to show up in the right searches.
activity.descriptionTooltip: This description will appear in search results. Be clear, professional and mention your key services. Good examples: 'Electrician with 15 years of experience in residential and commercial installations' or 'Plumber specialising in 24/7 emergency repairs'.

location.title: Location and portfolio
location.subtitle: Fill in your location and add photos of your work
location.paymentTooltip: Tell clients which payment methods you accept. The more options you offer, the easier it is for clients to hire you. Bizum and bank transfer are the most popular in Spain.

portfolio.tooltip: Photos of your work are KEY. Profiles with more photos get 3x more contacts. You can publish without a photo and add one later from your profile.
